title: Practice 9: Running, swimming, climbing, crawling, dragging

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., imper. pl.) в окно.
exercises.why: **лезьте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) к Ленке!
exercises.why: **бегу** — future tense (1st person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (полезть — to climb (in); pf., imper. sg.) в очаг.
exercises.why: **полезай** — imperative (ты, singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Я почти ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., past m. sg.).
exercises.why: **бежал** — past tense (masculine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Куда мы ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.)?
exercises.why: **бежим** — future tense (1st person plural) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., imper. sg.) к нему!
exercises.why: **лезь** — imperative (ты, singular) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: На крышу ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.).
exercises.why: **бегу** — future tense (1st person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., past f. sg.) я к нему.
exercises.why: **бежала** — past tense (feminine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., imper. pl.) за попом!
exercises.why: **бегите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Куда вы ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **лезете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: От кого ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?.
exercises.why: **бежишь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., imper. pl.)… он идет!
exercises.why: **бегите** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (тащить — to drag, one way; impf., imper. sg.) их сюда!
exercises.why: **тащи** — imperative (ты, singular) of тащить: one-direction verb (many directions: таскать).

exercises.q: А убийцы ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., past pl.)!
exercises.why: **бежали** — past tense (plural) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., past f. sg.) в курник.
exercises.why: **бежала** — past tense (feminine) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: И к вам ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., past m. sg.)?
exercises.why: **лез** — past tense (masculine) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).

exercises.q: Он ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.) назад.
exercises.why: **бежит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: Ну и ___ (кататься — to roll (oneself); impf., past f. sg.)!
exercises.why: **каталась** — past tense (feminine) of кататься: many-directions verb (one direction: катиться).

exercises.q: И вот он ___ (бежать — to run, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.).
exercises.why: **бежит** — future tense (3rd person singular) of бежать: one-direction verb (many directions: бегать).

exercises.q: ___ (лезть — to climb, one way; impf., imper. pl.) ко мне….
exercises.why: **лезьте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of лезть: one-direction verb (many directions: лазить).
